dialogues.jp: 「……いつの間にやら」
dialogues.en: "...When did it become like this?"
dialogues.text: "...When did it become like this?"

dialogues.jp:
窓の外の空は｛にわ／俄｝かに灰色のうす曇模様を呈して
いた。
dialogues.en:
The clouds outside the window were gathering and turning a
dark shade of grey.
dialogues.text:
The clouds outside the window were gathering and turning a
dark shade of grey.

dialogues.jp:
いかにも雨の降りそうな……って、もう降って
きたよ。
dialogues.en:
At this rate, it's going to start raining... and there it
goes.
dialogues.text:
At this rate, it's going to start raining... and there it
goes.

dialogues.jp:
当然、特にあてもなく、ぶらりと学園を訪れた
俺が傘なんて持っているわけもない。
dialogues.en:
Of course, I never bother to carry anything to school
nowadays, so I didn't have an umbrealla with me either.
dialogues.text:
Of course, I never bother to carry anything to school
nowadays, so I didn't have an umbrealla with me either.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁ、かったるいなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Haah, how troublesome..."
dialogues.text: "Haah, how troublesome..."

dialogues.jp:
どんよりした窓の外の灰色を恨めしく眺めなが
ら、溜息をついた。
dialogues.en: I glanced outside the window and sighed remorsefully.
dialogues.text: I glanced outside the window and sighed remorsefully.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「ん、どうした？　誰もいない教室で何か企て
　ているのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Hm, what is it? What are you plotting in this deserted
classroom?"
dialogues.text:
"Hm, what is it? What are you plotting in this deserted
classroom?"

dialogues.jp:
すると、いつの間にか姿を現していた杉並が、
楽しげな声色で聞いてくる。
dialogues.en:
Suginami's figure appeared behind me, his
irritatingly-cheerful voice ringing in my ears.
dialogues.text:
Suginami's figure appeared behind me, his
irritatingly-cheerful voice ringing in my ears.

dialogues.jp: 「……いや、雨が降ってきたなーと」
dialogues.en: "...Plotting to make the rain stop somehow."
dialogues.text: "...Plotting to make the rain stop somehow."

dialogues.jp:
俺は頬杖をつき、視線を動かさないまま、そう
答えた。
dialogues.en:
I continued staring outside the window, resting my chin on
my palm, while answering him.
dialogues.text:
I continued staring outside the window, resting my chin on
my palm, while answering him.

dialogues.speaker: SUginami
dialogues.jp: 「……なるほど。帰れない、と」
dialogues.en: "... I see. The road back is unpassable for you."
dialogues.text: "... I see. The road back is unpassable for you."

dialogues.jp: お見通しらしかった。
dialogues.en: Well, duh?
dialogues.text: Well, duh?

dialogues.jp: 「そういうお前は傘持ってきてるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Does that mean you have an umbrella?"
dialogues.text: "Does that mean you have an umbrella?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「備えあれば憂いなしだ、ほれ」
dialogues.en: "I'm always prepared for anything. Check it out."
dialogues.text: "I'm always prepared for anything. Check it out."

dialogues.jp:
すちゃっ、と懐から携帯用折畳傘を抜き出して
みせる杉並。
dialogues.en:
He revealed a small, portable umbrella from within his shirt
pocket.
dialogues.text:
He revealed a small, portable umbrella from within his shirt
pocket.

dialogues.jp: その余裕ある態度が妙に憎たらしい。
dialogues.en: He really irritates me sometimes...
dialogues.text: He really irritates me sometimes...

dialogues.en: "You traitor......"
dialogues.text: "You traitor......"

dialogues.jp:
精一杯恨めしげな視線を送る俺の目の前で、こ
れ見よがしに傘を振りかざした。
dialogues.en:
I alternated between deathly glares towards Suginami, and
longing gazes at his umbrella.
dialogues.text:
I alternated between deathly glares towards Suginami, and
longing gazes at his umbrella.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「わははは、そう言うな。｛おとこ／漢｝たるもの、雨の中
　をダッシュするくらいの気概を持たねば！」
dialogues.en:
"Wahahaha, say all you want. If you're a true man, go ahead
and dash through that downpour to your home!"
dialogues.text:
"Wahahaha, say all you want. If you're a true man, go ahead
and dash through that downpour to your home!"

dialogues.jp: 他人事だと思って好きなことをぬかす杉並。
dialogues.en: As wild an idea as usual from Suginami.
dialogues.text: As wild an idea as usual from Suginami.

dialogues.jp: 「………………かったりぃよ」
dialogues.en: "........That's troublesome."
dialogues.text: "........That's troublesome."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「それじゃ、仲睦まじく相合傘で帰るか？」
dialogues.en:
"Well then, shall we huddle together tightly under this tiny
little umbrella?"
dialogues.text:
"Well then, shall we huddle together tightly under this tiny
little umbrella?"

dialogues.jp:
その図を想像して、俺はうすら寒い気分に襲わ
れた。
dialogues.en: That image in my head brought shivers up and down my spine.
dialogues.text: That image in my head brought shivers up and down my spine.

dialogues.jp: 「丁重にお断りする」
dialogues.en: "I politely refuse."
dialogues.text: "I politely refuse."

dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと待ってりゃ止むだろ」
dialogues.en: "...If I wait patiently, it'd stop raining."
dialogues.text: "...If I wait patiently, it'd stop raining."

dialogues.jp: 朝は降ってなかったんだし、
dialogues.en: Just like the sun rising from the east.
dialogues.text: Just like the sun rising from the east.

dialogues.jp: ――きっと止んでくれるだろう。
dialogues.en: --It'd definitely stop.
dialogues.text: --It'd definitely stop.

dialogues.jp: いや、止むさ、止むとき、止まねば、止め！
dialogues.en: No, it will, and it will stop now!
dialogues.text: No, it will, and it will stop now!

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか。じゃ、健闘を祈る」
dialogues.en: "If you say so. I'll pray for your success."
dialogues.text: "If you say so. I'll pray for your success."

dialogues.jp:
にやりと笑って、軽く言い残すと杉並はさっさ
と姿を消した。
dialogues.en: He left the room, grinning knowingly.
dialogues.text: He left the room, grinning knowingly.

dialogues.jp:
ひとり取り残された俺は相変わらず頬杖をつい
たまま、窓の外を眺め続けた。
dialogues.en:
Alone once again, I returned to my pose of solitude, staring
outside the window.
dialogues.text:
Alone once again, I returned to my pose of solitude, staring
outside the window.

dialogues.en: --*patter patter patter*
dialogues.text: --*patter patter patter*

dialogues.jp: さあ、止め！
dialogues.en: Now, stop!
dialogues.text: Now, stop!

dialogues.en: --*pat pat pat*
dialogues.text: --*pat pat pat*

dialogues.jp: 止めよ！
dialogues.en: Halt!
dialogues.text: Halt!

dialogues.en: --*pit pit pit pit*
dialogues.text: --*pit pit pit pit*

dialogues.jp: 止めったら！
dialogues.en: Stop at once!
dialogues.text: Stop at once!

dialogues.jp: どざあああぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁ…………………。
dialogues.en: --*patterpatterpatterrrrr*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatterpatterrrrr*

dialogues.jp:
しかし俺の願いなどお構いなしに、むしろ喧嘩
を売っているかのごとく春の雨は止むどころか
時と共に激しさを増していく。
dialogues.en:
Unfortunately, my wish was not entertained, as the rain
continued to beat onto the window.
dialogues.text:
Unfortunately, my wish was not entertained, as the rain
continued to beat onto the window.

dialogues.jp:
しまいには、ばしゃばしゃと強い音を立てて台
風チックに窓を濡らし始める有様だ。
dialogues.en:
If anything, it seems almost stronger now, raindrops flowing
faster down the window.
dialogues.text:
If anything, it seems almost stronger now, raindrops flowing
faster down the window.

dialogues.jp:
（非常に不本意でも杉並の言葉に甘えるべきだっ
　たのか？………………）
dialogues.en: "(Maybe I should have took up Suginami's offer?......)"
dialogues.text: "(Maybe I should have took up Suginami's offer?......)"

dialogues.jp: 後悔先に立たず、とはこのことか。
dialogues.en: A quick moment of regret washed over me.
dialogues.text: A quick moment of regret washed over me.

dialogues.jp:
……あいつの最後に残した笑みはこの事を予知
していたに違いない。
dialogues.en:
...But seeing that bloody grin on his face in my mind's eye
was enough to convince me that I made the right choice.
dialogues.text:
...But seeing that bloody grin on his face in my mind's eye
was enough to convince me that I made the right choice.

dialogues.en: --*patterpatterpatter*
dialogues.text: --*patterpatterpatter*

dialogues.jp:
がらんとした教室に響く雨音が空しさに拍車を
かける。
dialogues.en:
The sound of raindrops striking the window echoed around the
classroom.
dialogues.text:
The sound of raindrops striking the window echoed around the
classroom.

dialogues.jp: きっとここは陸の孤島。
dialogues.en: This is a true solitary island.
dialogues.text: This is a true solitary island.

dialogues.jp:
「……この際、贅沢は言わん。杉並でも誰でも
　いいから、戻ってきてくれぇ〜」
dialogues.en:
"...In this kind of situation, I can't be choosy. Suginami,
anyone, please come baaaaack..."
dialogues.text:
"...In this kind of situation, I can't be choosy. Suginami,
anyone, please come baaaaack..."

dialogues.jp:
そんななさけない言葉を呟いていると、からか
らと後ろのドアが開く音がした。
dialogues.en:
As I cried out pitifully, as if granting my wish, I heard
the door behind me open.
dialogues.text:
As I cried out pitifully, as if granting my wish, I heard
the door behind me open.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、まだ帰ってなかったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, you haven't gone home yet?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura, you haven't gone home yet?"

dialogues.jp:
振り返ると、工藤が「なにやってんだ」という
表情で覗き込んでいた。
dialogues.en:
Turning my head around, Kudou had a "what are you doing"
expression on his face.
dialogues.text:
Turning my head around, Kudou had a "what are you doing"
expression on his face.

dialogues.jp: 「……お前こそ、まだ残ってたのかよ」
dialogues.en: "...Neither have you, apparently."
dialogues.text: "...Neither have you, apparently."

dialogues.jp: そう言ってある可能性に気付く。
dialogues.en: As I said those words, the possibility struck me.
dialogues.text: As I said those words, the possibility struck me.

dialogues.jp:
「おっーっ！　もしかして、お前も傘を持って
　きてない俺の同士か！？」
dialogues.en:
"Oooooohh! Are you my soulmate in not posessing an umbrella
too!?"
dialogues.text:
"Oooooohh! Are you my soulmate in not posessing an umbrella
too!?"

dialogues.jp:
だからどうってことは無いが――少なくともこ
の、なんだか訳のわからない孤独感を味わうの
は俺一人じゃなくなる。
dialogues.en:
I sounded a bit more excited than I should be -- perhaps the
isolation really had gotten to me.
dialogues.text:
I sounded a bit more excited than I should be -- perhaps the
isolation really had gotten to me.

dialogues.jp: しかし工藤は無常にも言い放った。
dialogues.en: But Kudou's uncertain reply crushed my hopes and dreams.
dialogues.text: But Kudou's uncertain reply crushed my hopes and dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや、予報見たから傘なら持ってるけど」
dialogues.en:
"N, no, I saw the weather forecast, so I brought an
umbrella."
dialogues.text:
"N, no, I saw the weather forecast, so I brought an
umbrella."

dialogues.jp: そんなこと当然だろう、と言わんばかりの口調。
dialogues.en: "Of course I did", his words implied.
dialogues.text: "Of course I did", his words implied.

dialogues.jp: 俺は脱力のあまりずるずると机にへたりこんだ。
dialogues.en: Exhausted, I collapsed onto my desk.
dialogues.text: Exhausted, I collapsed onto my desk.

dialogues.jp:
……まったくどいつもこいつも、なんでこんな
に用意周到なのだ。
dialogues.en:
...Looks like everyone came to school thoroughly prepared
for this to happen.
dialogues.text:
...Looks like everyone came to school thoroughly prepared
for this to happen.

dialogues.jp:
まるで傘を持ってこなかった俺のほうが、イレ
ギュラーな存在みたいじゃないか。
dialogues.en: Except for myself, the irregular without an umbrella.
dialogues.text: Except for myself, the irregular without an umbrella.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……お前、なにをがっかりしてるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "...What are you feeling so down about?"
dialogues.text: "...What are you feeling so down about?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや、何も……」
dialogues.en: "Nothing much..."
dialogues.text: "Nothing much..."

dialogues.jp: なんかもう説明する気力も失せた。
dialogues.en: I didn't have the energy to even explain to him anymore.
dialogues.text: I didn't have the energy to even explain to him anymore.

dialogues.jp:
｛うなだ／項垂｝れた俺は、意味なく床のしみの数をひとつ
ふたつと数えてみたりする。
dialogues.en:
I simply tiredly rested my head on my desk, drained of all
vitality.
dialogues.text:
I simply tiredly rested my head on my desk, drained of all
vitality.

dialogues.jp: 工藤はそんな俺を見つめ、おもむろに頷いた。
dialogues.en:
Kudou looked at me for a bit, then started to nod his head
slowly.
dialogues.text:
Kudou looked at me for a bit, then started to nod his head
slowly.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……ああ、そういうことか？　雨宿りのつも
　りが帰るチャンスを逸したと………………」
dialogues.en: "...Ahh, that's how it is? Trying to wait out the rain?..."
dialogues.text: "...Ahh, that's how it is? Trying to wait out the rain?..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……まぁな」
dialogues.en: "...Pretty much."
dialogues.text: "...Pretty much."

dialogues.jp: ｛うな／唸｝るように答える。
dialogues.en: I groaned out a reply.
dialogues.text: I groaned out a reply.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「｛あいにく／生憎｝朝のニュースによると、この雨は夜半過
　ぎまで続くらしいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Er, sorry, but the morning news said that this rain would
continue on well past midnight."
dialogues.text:
"Er, sorry, but the morning news said that this rain would
continue on well past midnight."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「にゃにおうぅぅぅぅぅぅぅ！？」
dialogues.en: "Whaaaaaaaaaaat!?"
dialogues.text: "Whaaaaaaaaaaat!?"

dialogues.jp: 工藤の言葉に、俺は勢いよく顔をあげた。
dialogues.en: My face shot up from the desk from Kudou's sentence.
dialogues.text: My face shot up from the desk from Kudou's sentence.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに今度は『そんなもん当たるわけねーよ』
と切り捨ててここに居残る気にはならない。
dialogues.en: That means that there's obviously no point in staying here.
dialogues.text: That means that there's obviously no point in staying here.

dialogues.jp:
「……もはや、新聞紙かぶって走るしか、脱出
　の道はないのか……」
dialogues.en:
"...I guess I'd have to find a newspaper somewhere and do a
runner..."
dialogues.text:
"...I guess I'd have to find a newspaper somewhere and do a
runner..."

dialogues.jp:
悲壮な覚悟を決める俺に、工藤が苦笑いを漏ら
す。
dialogues.en:
Preparing myself for the worst, Kudou laughed a little at
me.
dialogues.text:
Preparing myself for the worst, Kudou laughed a little at
me.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「よせってば、イヤミくさいなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Quit it with the pity act."
dialogues.text: "Quit it with the pity act."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「なんだったら、俺が傘に入れてってやるよ」
dialogues.en: "Come on, I'd let you share my umbrella."
dialogues.text: "Come on, I'd let you share my umbrella."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「マジか！？」
dialogues.en: "Really!?"
dialogues.text: "Really!?"

dialogues.jp: やはり持つべきものは友！　地獄に仏！！
dialogues.en: A true friend, a Buddha in hell!!
dialogues.text: A true friend, a Buddha in hell!!

dialogues.jp: ありがとう、ありがとう。
dialogues.en: Thank you, thank you!
dialogues.text: Thank you, thank you!

dialogues.jp:
俺は工藤の両手をぎゅっと握り締め、ぶんぶん
と上下に振る。
dialogues.en: I grabbed Kudou's hands and bowed several times.
dialogues.text: I grabbed Kudou's hands and bowed several times.

dialogues.jp:
もう、この際、野郎二人の相合傘が嫌だなんて
言っていられない。
dialogues.en:
I can't say no to sharing an umbrella under these
circumstances, no matter the other person.
dialogues.text:
I can't say no to sharing an umbrella under these
circumstances, no matter the other person.

dialogues.jp: 「お前って、本っ当、いい奴だなー！」
dialogues.en: "You're a a real friend!"
dialogues.text: "You're a a real friend!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「やめろって、大袈裟な」
dialogues.en: "Stop it, you're exaggerating..."
dialogues.text: "Stop it, you're exaggerating..."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は困ったように顔を染め、俺の手を振り｛ほど／解｝
いた。
dialogues.en:
With a slightly regretful face, Kudou managed to dig his
hands out from my grasp.
dialogues.text:
With a slightly regretful face, Kudou managed to dig his
hands out from my grasp.

dialogues.jp:
「ただ入れてもらうのも気がひけるし、傘は俺
　が持つよ」
dialogues.en:
"Since you were so gracious as to accomodate me, I'd hold
the umbrella."
dialogues.text:
"Since you were so gracious as to accomodate me, I'd hold
the umbrella."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は工藤から傘を半ば強引に受け取り、バッと
開いた。
dialogues.en:
I half-forced the umbrella out of Kudou's hand, and popped
it open.
dialogues.text:
I half-forced the umbrella out of Kudou's hand, and popped
it open.

dialogues.jp: 結構でかい傘だな。しっかり二人入れそうだ。
dialogues.en: It's pretty big. It'd definitely cover at least two people.
dialogues.text: It's pretty big. It'd definitely cover at least two people.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、工藤、とっとと行こうぜ」
dialogues.en: "Come on Kudou, let's go."
dialogues.text: "Come on Kudou, let's go."

dialogues.jp:
こんな雨の中に立ち尽くすのはごめんだ。俺は
なんだかポゥッとしている工藤の手を引いて、
歩き出した。
dialogues.en:
Sorry, but I don't feel like standing here in the rain. I
grabbed his hand, and pulled him with me as I walked.
dialogues.text:
Sorry, but I don't feel like standing here in the rain. I
grabbed his hand, and pulled him with me as I walked.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Ahh!?"
dialogues.text: "Ahh!?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「チャキチャキ行こうぜ。というか、何か自分
　で傘を持っていないと不安とか、そういう事
　とかあるのか？」
dialogues.en:
"We should get to our homes as quick as possible. Oh yeah,
you don't mind me holding the umbrella, do you?"
dialogues.text:
"We should get to our homes as quick as possible. Oh yeah,
you don't mind me holding the umbrella, do you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に」
dialogues.en: "No, not really."
dialogues.text: "No, not really."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、いいよな。ほんと、さっさと行こう
　ぜ」
dialogues.en: "Then it's fine. Come on, I'm going to go without you."
dialogues.text: "Then it's fine. Come on, I'm going to go without you."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Ah, ahh..."
dialogues.text: "Ah, ahh..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "Thank you."
dialogues.text: "Thank you."

dialogues.jp: おかしなヤツ。
dialogues.en: What a weird guy.
dialogues.text: What a weird guy.

dialogues.jp: 大きな傘に、俺たちはスッポリ覆われている。
dialogues.en:
The big umbrella was easily sheltering both of us rom the
reain.
dialogues.text:
The big umbrella was easily sheltering both of us rom the
reain.

dialogues.jp:
「いや、しかし本当、マヂで助かった。これが
　運命というものか……」
dialogues.en:
"No, I should be the one thanking you. It was almost like
fate..."
dialogues.text:
"No, I should be the one thanking you. It was almost like
fate..."

dialogues.jp: 俺は半ば本気で感謝の念を贈る。
dialogues.en: I half-seriously thanked him.
dialogues.text: I half-seriously thanked him.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「バーカ。何言ってんだか」
dialogues.en: "Stupid, what are you saying!"
dialogues.text: "Stupid, what are you saying!"

dialogues.jp:
いつものように、「困った奴だ」とでも言いた
げな苦笑いをもらす工藤。
dialogues.en:
As always, Kudou looked at me with a "what a regrettable
fellow" smile.
dialogues.text:
As always, Kudou looked at me with a "what a regrettable
fellow" smile.

dialogues.jp: いつの間にか、いつもの工藤に戻っていた。
dialogues.en:
No matter the time or place, Kudou had always been like
that.
dialogues.text:
No matter the time or place, Kudou had always been like
that.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ちゃんと毎朝のニュースぐらいチェックして
　来いよ〜。そんな調子じゃ戦争が始まっても
　気付かないだろ」
dialogues.en:
"You should watch the news every morning, you know. At this
rate, if a war started, you wouldn't know about it."
dialogues.text:
"You should watch the news every morning, you know. At this
rate, if a war started, you wouldn't know about it."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ニュースねぇ……かったるいんだよな」
dialogues.en: "News... that's troublesome."
dialogues.text: "News... that's troublesome."

dialogues.jp:
そんな暇があったらもっと別のことに時間を使
いたいもんだ。
dialogues.en:
I could easily do something else with the time wasted on
that.
dialogues.text:
I could easily do something else with the time wasted on
that.

dialogues.jp: 例えば遅刻ぎりぎりまで寝るとか……。
dialogues.en: Such as sleeping that bit later...
dialogues.text: Such as sleeping that bit later...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そう言うと思ったよ」
dialogues.en: "If that's what you think."
dialogues.text: "If that's what you think."

dialogues.jp:
俺の返答に、溜息｛ま／雑｝じりで呟く工藤。そういや、
こいつとこんなふうにサシで会話したことって
あまり無かったな……。
dialogues.en:
At my reply, he simply sighed and gave up. I guess he didn't
really want to continue the conversation...
dialogues.text:
At my reply, he simply sighed and gave up. I guess he didn't
really want to continue the conversation...

dialogues.jp:
その時、どこからか、ふっとシトラス系の香り
が漂ってきた。
dialogues.en: Just then, a certain scent graced my nostrils.
dialogues.text: Just then, a certain scent graced my nostrils.

dialogues.jp: （似たような香りをどこかで……）
dialogues.en: "(It smells familiar somehow...)"
dialogues.text: "(It smells familiar somehow...)"

dialogues.jp: （そういや、音夢もこんな香りがするよな）
dialogues.en: "(That's right, I've smelt this scent on Nemu before.)"
dialogues.text: "(That's right, I've smelt this scent on Nemu before.)"

dialogues.jp: そして思い当たった。
dialogues.en: Then it struck me.
dialogues.text: Then it struck me.

dialogues.jp: ああ、そうだ。これはシャンプーの香りだ。
dialogues.en: Ahh, that's right. This is the smell of shampoo.
dialogues.text: Ahh, that's right. This is the smell of shampoo.

dialogues.jp:
あらためて見てみると雨露を帯びた工藤の髪は
しっとりとつややかな光沢を放っている。
dialogues.en:
I looked over again at Kudou, raindrops glistening brightly
from his hair.
dialogues.text:
I looked over again at Kudou, raindrops glistening brightly
from his hair.

dialogues.jp:
面倒な時には石鹸でがしがし洗ってしまう俺の
頭とはそもそも髪質からして違う、という気さ
えする。
dialogues.en:
He probably uses more than the soap and water that I use to
wash his hair...
dialogues.text:
He probably uses more than the soap and water that I use to
wash his hair...

dialogues.jp:
「お前さぁ、女物のシャンプーとか使ってるの
　か？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, do you use girl's shampoo?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, do you use girl's shampoo?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は何気なく尋ねてみた。
dialogues.en: I idly brought up the topic.
dialogues.text: I idly brought up the topic.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「いや……さっきからいい香りがするな、と思っ
　て」
dialogues.en: "Well... I thought I smelt something really nice earlier."
dialogues.text: "Well... I thought I smelt something really nice earlier."

dialogues.jp:
すると工藤は「何故わかったんだ」というよう
な顔になった。
dialogues.en: I explained to Kudou's "how did you know?" expression.
dialogues.text: I explained to Kudou's "how did you know?" expression.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「た……たまたまだよ。オレの使ってるやつが
　なくなっちゃって、姉貴のを借りたんだけど
　……そんな、気になるか？」
dialogues.en:
"I...it was neccessary. I ran out of what I normally used,
so I had to borrow my sister's.... you noticed that?"
dialogues.text:
"I...it was neccessary. I ran out of what I normally used,
so I had to borrow my sister's.... you noticed that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「あー……まぁ、少なくとも、俺が音夢のシャ
　ンプーを使うことはありえないな」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh... Wow, I wouldn't even think of using Nemu's shampoo,
even if there was no other choice."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh... Wow, I wouldn't even think of using Nemu's shampoo,
even if there was no other choice."

dialogues.jp:
女兄弟がいる家だとそういうのが普通の所もあ
るのかもしれないが、
dialogues.en:
It's not a case of whether it's normal for siblings to share
shampoo or whatever either.
dialogues.text:
It's not a case of whether it's normal for siblings to share
shampoo or whatever either.

dialogues.jp:
俺個人としては、フローラルやらシトラスやら
の香りのする男っていうのはちょっとなぁ……。
dialogues.en:
I just can't see myself, as a man, using shampoo with a
floral scent...
dialogues.text:
I just can't see myself, as a man, using shampoo with a
floral scent...

dialogues.jp: 「……まぁお前は女顔だしな」
dialogues.en: "...Oh well, you have a girl's face anyway."
dialogues.text: "...Oh well, you have a girl's face anyway."

dialogues.jp: 似合わんこともない、か……。
dialogues.en: So it's not entirely unsuited to him...
dialogues.text: So it's not entirely unsuited to him...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「女顔で悪かったな！　先行っちまうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Geez, sorry for that! I'm moving on ahead!"
dialogues.text: "Geez, sorry for that! I'm moving on ahead!"

dialogues.jp:
とたんに工藤は怒ったような声を出し、傘をも
ぎ取るように俺の手から奪うと、すたすたと早
足で歩き出した。
dialogues.en:
Kudou grabbed the umbrella from me and started walking
faster in a huff.
dialogues.text:
Kudou grabbed the umbrella from me and started walking
faster in a huff.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、待て工藤、悪かった、謝るって！！」
dialogues.en: "W, wait Kudou, I'm sorry, I apologize!"
dialogues.text: "W, wait Kudou, I'm sorry, I apologize!"

dialogues.jp:
俺は慌てて、へこへこ頭を下げながらそのあと
を追った。
dialogues.en:
I chased after him, bowing my head and apologizing the whole
time.
dialogues.text:
I chased after him, bowing my head and apologizing the whole
time.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉んち、ここだろ」
dialogues.en: "Your stop is here, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Your stop is here, Asakura."

dialogues.jp:
家の前までやってくる頃には、雨もだいぶ小降
りになってきていた。
dialogues.en:
By the time we reached my house, the rain seemed to have let
up a little.
dialogues.text:
By the time we reached my house, the rain seemed to have let
up a little.

dialogues.jp: 「悪かったな、結局、家まで付き合わせて」
dialogues.en: "Sorry for lengthening your exposure to this weather."
dialogues.text: "Sorry for lengthening your exposure to this weather."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いいって。大した手間でもないし」
dialogues.en: "It's okay, nothing major."
dialogues.text: "It's okay, nothing major."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「この埋め合わせはいつかきっとするから」
dialogues.en: "I'd make it up to you sometime, definitely."
dialogues.text: "I'd make it up to you sometime, definitely."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あはは、期待しないで待ってるよ」
dialogues.en: "Ahaha, I'd be waiting for that."
dialogues.text: "Ahaha, I'd be waiting for that."

dialogues.jp:
気の置けない笑顔を見せて、工藤は｛さっそう／颯爽｝と身を
翻して去っていった。
dialogues.en:
With a smile and a wave, Kudou gallantly left in the
opposite direction.
dialogues.text:
With a smile and a wave, Kudou gallantly left in the
opposite direction.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、工藤が女子に人気があるのも頷け
る気がした。
dialogues.en: In a way, I can see why he's so popular with the girls now.
dialogues.text: In a way, I can see why he's so popular with the girls now.

dialogues.jp: ◆持つべきものは友◆
dialogues.en: ◆Ever-Prepared Friend◆
dialogues.text: ◆Ever-Prepared Friend◆

dialogues.jp:
待てど暮らせど止まない雨、｛あいにく／生憎｝傘を持ってい
かなかった俺は工藤の傘に入れてもらって帰る
ことに……。
dialogues.en:
Watching me wait for the neverending torrent of rain, Kudou
took pity on me and let me tag along under his umbrella.
dialogues.text:
Watching me wait for the neverending torrent of rain, Kudou
took pity on me and let me tag along under his umbrella.

dialogues.jp:
ただ入れてもらうのも悪い気がしたので、傘は
俺がさすことにしたが。
dialogues.en:
As a manner of thanks, I offered to hold the umbrella for
us.
dialogues.text:
As a manner of thanks, I offered to hold the umbrella for
us.

dialogues.jp:
途中、不用意に、女っぽいと指摘して怒らせて
しまったりもしたが、工藤は俺をちゃんと家ま
で送ってくれたのだった。
dialogues.en:
After a slight skirmish over a matter of the feminine order,
Kudou escorted me to my home.
dialogues.text:
After a slight skirmish over a matter of the feminine order,
Kudou escorted me to my home.

dialogues.jp: さすが女子の人気者、いい奴だ。
dialogues.en: He's popular with the girls for good reason, after all.
dialogues.text: He's popular with the girls for good reason, after all.
